findings.passage: I am alarmed by proposals to enact laws that could disenfranchise voters. I believe our communities are stronger when more people participate in government and I look forward to continuing the fight to expand and protect voting access.
findings.note: Campaign site Voting Access priority. She says she is alarmed by proposals for laws that could disenfranchise voters and wants to expand and protect voting access. It names no specific ID or citizenship rule. The page itself shows no date (site was last modified 2026-09-10 per page metadata).

findings.passage: In the State Senate, we have passed many bills to protect voting rights, including the Michigan Voting Rights Act.
findings.note: Same campaign page. She cites Senate passage of voting-rights bills, including the Michigan Voting Rights Act, with no mention of ID or citizenship rules.
